headline: Chevron Increases Exploration Spending by 50% for Global Frontier Assets
summary: Chevron is raising its exploration spending by 50% to focus on high-impact frontier exploration in South America, Africa, and the Eastern Mediterranean alongside its core U.S. operations.
why: Chevron is one of the world's largest integrated energy companies. Its capital allocation decisions indicate long-term upstream investment strategies and global reserve replenishment plans.

impacts.name: Chevron Corporation
impacts.why: Chevron is boosting its capital budget for international frontier exploration by 50%.
